# Quality Tab and Experiment Redesign Planning
Date: 2026-10-27 | Duration: 22.1299991607666m

## Summary
The discussion defined the Quality experience and its delivery direction. The Quality tab should sit in the right rail, while configuration remains in the left-side workspace; a wider or collapsed rail provides more room for inline changes (00:30, 02:04, 03:45, 12:32). Descriptions should connect closely to the hypothesis, document experiment context, and remain separate from state documentation (04:50–05:52). Quality checks should be optional and customizable, with required items limited to essential entries (06:41). The scoring experience should retain the donut chart, start with content collapsed by default, expand problematic states when appropriate, and keep overrides visually secondary (08:06–10:49). Project overrides should use a CRUD table with one hierarchy level, while slider interaction and section-level disabling require attention (14:28–16:40). The design is ready for integration without higher fidelity initially; experiment redesign is targeted for version 5.2, and dashboard feedback will be handled separately (19:55–20:39).

## Keywords
Quality tab, Experiment configuration, Right rail, Project overrides, Quality scoring, Dashboard redesign

## Action Items

- Send design links (20:01)
- Notify Graham about changes (20:22)

**Graham McNicoll**
